tool.help:
**ProTrek: Trimodal Protein Search (FREE)**
Search 5B+ proteins by function description, sequence, or structure. 100x faster than Foldseek and MMseqs2!
**No GPU or local computation required!**
**Search Types:** - **Function**: Natural language description (e.g., "kinase that phosphorylates tyrosine") - **Sequence**: Amino acid sequence for similarity search
**Databases:** - UniProt: Curated protein database - NCBI: 700 million sequences - MGnify: 3 billion metagenomic proteins
**Citation:** ProTrek: Trimodal protein language model. Nature Biotechnology (2025)
